title: Doors Seek Chase
blurb: The Seek chase is where Roblox Doors stops being a hide-and-hold game and turns into a full sprint through collapsing hallways, and this frantic, driving theme is what carries it. Every choice in the mix exists to make you panic and misjudge a doorway: the tempo, the low end, the sense that the track is running slightly ahead of your feet. Composers on free Roblox titles are not obliged to try this hard. This one did, and the chase is now the most-clipped moment in the game.
origin: The Seek chase sequence music from Roblox Doors.
